proposed_commit_title: Preserve MCP integration tooling, documentation and historical records
proposed_commit_body:
Reconcile preserved MCP source intent with the current runtime architecture across development acceptance and registry tooling, packaging support, canonical import owners, configuration and documentation. Keep paired technical-document relocation and generated root import inventories with their owning consumers. Recover preserved historical plan and execution evidence while retaining the accepted runtime-without-service-manager decision.

Immutable original-base/snapshot dispositions and later-source receipts are recorded in the integration handoffs; source generations remain distinct, including592 later paths preserved outside the MCP integration scope. This baseline checkpoint records implemented work and does not claim completion of pending integrated or installed-runtime verification.
atomic_dependencies: Four dev callers of renamed public product CLI contract modules are excluded for S03 atomic source commit; do not silently include them here as well. Alternatively commit S04 first with those four consumers and add S03 source immediately before verification, but complete atomic rename is preferred.
technical/** deletions and docs/technical/** additions plus translated technical catalogues stay together.

dev/quality/metadata/import_load_targets.{cadrumo,cadrumo_harness,dev,docs}.json and owning compiler/reader changes plus import-worker exhaustive closure are one generated inventory closure; app entrypoint metadata is excluded for S03 rename ownership.
Income installed TUI helper public defining names and direct dev callers stay together; fixture changes retain installed origin, stdin-only credentials and explicit boot-bounded development policy.

Recovered historical Vault records have already been repaired through owning CLI by supervisor; checkpoint their actual bytes without manufacturing Step completion. Integration feature plan/ledger/audit final checkpoint remains excluded.
withholding_latest_correction: Root native worker reports exclusive edits frozen; both concrete current runner/test bytes included.
